action_cards.title: Save the Printful key in GitHub
steps: 1. Printful: developers.printful.com, sign in, create a read-only token named Sanctuary Grace for the store Sanctuary Grace Shop, and copy it.
2. GitHub: Transform24/THE-QUIET-AUTHORITY, Settings, Secrets and variables, Actions, New repository secret.
3. Name it exactly SANCTUARY_GRACE_KEY, paste the token, and click Add secret.
4. Tell Claude: The key is saved. Never paste the key in chat.
5. Also confirm UPS Mail Innovations on the wall art in Printful, Settings, Shipping.
action_cards.note: Full steps are in content-ops/06_storefront-sync/Q4-HOLIDAY-SETUP.md on the tqa-compositions branch. The shop filter that hides unverified Printful links is built there too. It reaches the live site only when published to main.
